name: brex
description: Connect Brex to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Brex MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Brex to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with expenses, cards, and bills using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Brex workspace.
Find anything in Brex that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review expenses, cards, and bills in Brex.
